howto.what: 安装后，Claude会引导你为CLI工具编写自定义命令。你只需编辑custom.rs文件，注册命令，SDK客户端会自动继承CLI的认证、重试、TLS等配置，无需额外设置。
howto.when: 当你需要给api-wide-base-path-with-default CLI添加自定义命令时，编辑custom.rs并注册命令，之后构建CLI即可使用。

say.text: 添加一个widgets-create命令，接收apiVersion参数。
say.note: 触发Claude生成对应的Rust代码示例。

say.text: 如何在custom.rs中注册命令并调用SDK？
帮我创建一个新命令，继承CLI的全局配置。
say.note: Claude会生成含认证、重试的完整代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you to write custom commands for the CLI tool. You edit custom.rs, register commands, and the SDK client automatically inherits auth, retries, TLS, etc., with zero configuration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to add custom commands to the api-wide-base-path-with-default CLI. Edit custom.rs, register commands, then build the CLI.

say_en.text: Add a widgets-create command with a required apiVersion argument.
say_en.note: Claude generates corresponding Rust code example.

say_en.text: How to register commands and call SDK in custom.rs?
Create a new command inheriting CLI global config.
say_en.note: Claude generates code including auth and retries.
